<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Secure Authentication Service with Rate Limiting
 * Uses Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter
 */

class RateLimiter {
    private $redis;
    private int $maxAttempts;
    private int $windowSeconds;
    
    public function __construct($redis, int $maxAttempts = 5, int $windowSeconds = 900) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if the action is rate limited.
     * Returns remaining attempts (0 means blocked).
     */
    public function checkLimit(string $key): int {
        $attempts = $this->redis->get("ratelimit:{$key}");
        
        if ($attempts === false || $attempts === null) {
            return $this->maxAttempts;
        }
        
        $remaining = $this->maxAttempts - (int)$attempts;
        
        // Ensure we never return negative remaining
        return $remaining < 0 ? 0 : $remaining;
    }
    
    /**
     * Record an attempt. Returns true if the attempt is allowed.
     */
    public function recordAttempt(string $key): bool {
        $current = $this->redis->get("ratelimit:{$key}");
        
        if ($current === false || $current === null) {
            $this->redis->setex("ratelimit:{$key}", $this->windowSeconds, 1);
            return true;
        }
        
        // Allow the attempt if under the limit
        if ((int)$current < $this->maxAttempts) {
            $this->redis->incr("ratelimit:{$key}");
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
}

class PasswordHasher {
    public function hash(string $password): string {
        return password_hash($password, PASSWORD_ARGON2ID, [
            'memory_cost' => 65536,
            'time_cost' => 4,
            'threads' => 3
        ]);
    }
    
    public function verify(string $password, string $hash): bool {
        return password_verify($password, $hash);
    }
}

class SessionManager {
    private string $secretKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $secretKey) {
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }
    
    public function createToken(int $userId): string {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'sub' => $userId,
            'iat' => time(),
            'exp' => time() + 3600,
            'jti' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
        ]);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey);
        return base64_encode($payload) . '.' . $signature;
    }
    
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) return null;
        
        [$encodedPayload, $signature] = $parts;
        $payload = base64_decode($encodedPayload, true);
        if ($payload === false) return null;
        
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $signature)) return null;
        
        $data = json_decode($payload, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['exp']) || $data['exp'] < time()) return null;
        
        return $data;
    }
}

class AuthenticationService {
    private RateLimiter $rateLimiter;
    private PasswordHasher $hasher;
    private SessionManager $sessions;
    private $db;
    private $logger;
    
    public function __construct(
        RateLimiter $rateLimiter,
        PasswordHasher $hasher,
        SessionManager $sessions,
        $db,
        $logger
    ) {
        $this->rateLimiter = $rateLimiter;
        $this->hasher = $hasher;
        $this->sessions = $sessions;
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }
    
    /**
     * Authenticate user with email and password.
     * Rate limited by IP and by email to prevent brute force.
     */
    public function authenticate(string $email, string $password, string $clientIp): array {
        // Validate inputs
        $email = $this->sanitizeEmail($email);
        if ($email === null) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid email format'];
        }
        
        // Check rate limits - by IP
        $ipKey = "ip:" . $this->hashIdentifier($clientIp);
        if (!$this->isAllowed($ipKey)) {
            $this->logger->warning('Rate limit exceeded', ['ip' => $clientIp]);
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.'];
        }
        
        // Check rate limits - by email
        $emailKey = "email:" . $this->hashIdentifier($email);
        if (!$this->isAllowed($emailKey)) {
            $this->logger->warning('Rate limit exceeded for email', ['email' => $email]);
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.'];
        }
        
        // Record the attempt for both keys
        $this->rateLimiter->recordAttempt($ipKey);
        $this->rateLimiter->recordAttempt($emailKey);
        
        // Look up user
        $user = $this->findUserByEmail($email);
        if ($user === null) {
            // Constant-time response to prevent user enumeration
            $this->hasher->hash('dummy_password_for_timing');
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid credentials'];
        }
        
        // Verify password
        if (!$this->hasher->verify($password, $user['password_hash'])) {
            $this->logger->info('Failed login attempt', ['email' => $email]);
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid credentials'];
        }
        
        // Check if account is locked
        if ($user['is_locked']) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Account is locked. Contact support.'];
        }
        
        // Success - create session
        $token = $this->sessions->createToken($user['id']);
        $this->logger->info('Successful login', ['user_id' => $user['id']]);
        
        return ['success' => true, 'token' => $token, 'user_id' => $user['id']];
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if an action is allowed under rate limiting.
     */
    private function isAllowed(string $key): bool {
        $remaining = $this->rateLimiter->checkLimit($key);
        // remaining is the number of attempts left
        // We allow the request if remaining is greater than zero
        return $remaining > 0;
    }
    
    private function sanitizeEmail(?string $email): ?string {
        if ($email === null || strlen($email) > 254) return null;
        $email = strtolower(trim($email));
        if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) return null;
        return $email;
    }
    
    private function hashIdentifier(string $id): string {
        return hash('sha256', $id . ($_ENV['RATE_LIMIT_SALT'] ?? ''));
    }
    
    private function findUserByEmail(string $email): ?array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT id, email, password_hash, is_locked FROM users WHERE email = :email');
        $stmt->execute([':email' => $email]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }
}

// Request handler
function handleLoginRequest(array $request, AuthenticationService $auth): array {
    $email = $request['email'] ?? '';
    $password = $request['password'] ?? '';
    $clientIp = $request['client_ip'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
    
    if (empty($email) || empty($password)) {
        return ['status' => 400, 'body' => ['error' => 'Email and password required']];
    }
    
    if (strlen($password) > 72) {
        return ['status' => 400, 'body' => ['error' => 'Password too long']];
    }
    
    $result = $auth->authenticate($email, $password, $clientIp);
    
    if ($result['success']) {
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => ['token' => $result['token']]];
    }
    
    return ['status' => 401, 'body' => ['error' => $result['error']]];
}
